name: Starfold
summary: A space art gallery page: warp-in starfield hero and six panels that open on hover
about: A two-screen gallery website for an art or photo portfolio, a music page or a creative studio. The hero is a live canvas starfield that warps in, drifts with your pointer and throws shooting stars past a ringed planet. Below, six artwork panels open with a springy accordion, and each work opens in a lightbox you can swipe through.
how: The page warps in: stars streak to rest, the planet rises and its ring draws, then the title words spring up
Move the pointer over the hero and the stars, planet and title drift at different depths
Hover, focus or tap a panel in the gallery and it springs open to show the title, artist and a View button
Press View (or tap an open panel) to zoom the work into a lightbox, then swipe, drag or use the arrow keys to move through all six
Scroll on to count up the gallery stats, draw the exhibition timeline and set Remind me stars for upcoming shows
Sign up to the newsletter: the email is checked, sends, and celebrates before the form resets
